## Code Review

This pull request introduces MoE linearization and repacking functionality, adding new configuration arguments and integrating these processes into the sequential calibration pipeline. It includes utility functions for detecting and managing MoE layers. The review identified several critical issues, including naming mismatches in configuration arguments, a failure to traverse nested submodules in MoE layers, dangerous parameter overwriting during module replacement, and potential GPU memory leaks due to improper offloading logic. Additionally, the tests require updates to align with the correct API and expected behavior.
